pr_title: [Feature][310P] support shared experts path in fused MoE for qwen3.5
source_quote: 检查重新初始化self.runner是否有必要

rule.description: 当父类在 `__init__` 中创建了依赖某些字段的组件（如 runner），而子类在后续才设置这些字段时，子类必须重新初始化该组件，以确保组件持有正确的字段引用。

antipattern.code:
# 父类 AscendFuseMoE310 在 __init__ 中调用 _create_runner() 创建 runner
class AscendFuseMoE310(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_experts = num_experts
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
        # ... 其他字段初始化 ...
        self._shared_experts = None       # 父类中未设置
        self.expert_gate = None           # 父类中未设置
        self._create_runner()             # 第一次创建 runner，此时 shared-experts/gate 为空

    def _create_runner(self):
        """创建 MoE runner，会将 shared-experts/gate 等字段传入"""
        self.runner = AscendMoERunner(
            shared_experts=self._shared_experts,
            expert_gate=self.expert_gate,
            ...
        )

# 子类 Qwen35SharedExpertsMoE310 设置字段后未重新创建 runner
class Qwen35SharedExpertsMoE310(AscendFuseMoE310):
    def __init__(self, num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...):
        super().__init__(num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...)
        # 父类已创建 runner，但此时 shared-experts/gate 仍为 None
        self._shared_experts = SharedExperts(...)  # 子类才设置
        self.expert_gate = ExpertGate(...)         # 子类才设置
        # ❌ 缺少 self._create_runner() 调用
        # runner 中引用的仍是 None 值

pattern.code:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class AscendFuseMoE310(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_experts = num_experts
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
        # ... 其他字段初始化 ...
        self._shared_experts = None
        self.expert_gate = None
        self._create_runner()

    def _create_runner(self):
        """创建 MoE runner，会将 shared-experts/gate 等字段传入"""
        self.runner = AscendMoERunner(
            shared_experts=self._shared_experts,
            expert_gate=self.expert_gate,
            ...
        )

    @property
    def is_internal_router(self) -> bool:
        return False

# 子类设置完字段后重新创建 runner，确保 runner 引用正确的字段
class Qwen35SharedExpertsMoE310(AscendFuseMoE310):
    def __init__(self, num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...):
        super().__init__(num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size, ...)
        # 父类已创建 runner，但 shared-experts/gate 仍为 None
        self._shared_experts = SharedExperts(...)
        self.expert_gate = ExpertGate(...)
        # ✅ 重新创建 runner，使其引用正确的 shared-experts/gate 字段
        self._create_runner()

    def _shared_experts_part1(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor):
        gate_up_out = self._shared_experts.gate_up_proj(hidden_states)
        if isinstance(gate_up_out, tuple):
            gate_up_out = gate_up_out[0]
        return gate_up_out

    def _shared_experts_part2(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
                               shared_gate_up: torch.Tensor):
        shared_act = self._shared_experts.act_fn(shared_gate_up)
        down_out = self._shared_experts.down_proj(shared_act)
        shared_out = down_out[0] if isinstance(down_out, tuple) else down_out
        # Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next shared-expert gate path
        if hasattr(self._shared_experts, "expert_gate") \
                and self._shared_experts.expert_gate is not None:
            gate_out = self._shared_experts.expert_gate(hidden_states)
            if isinstance(gate_out, tuple):
                gate_out = gate_out[0]
            shared_out = F.sigmoid(gate_out) * shared_out
        return shared_out
